title: SectionEntry
description: One entry in the `sections` object constant of a Rego module. Keys are section number strings (e.g. '1', '2', 'A'). The sections object captures structural metadata for each numbered section or appendix extracted from the directive body.

title.description: Section or appendix heading text as it appears in the directive.

excerpt.description: First 500 characters of the section body (truncated with '...' if longer), serving as a content preview for search and ontology indexing.

examples.title: Purpose
examples.excerpt: This regulation establishes policy and assigns responsibilities for preparing, reviewing, approving, and publishing Departmental directives...
